info.name: Parade Transactions Available Trucks Quotes API

items.docs:
Post your quotes here.

Each time a quote is created, we will display the carrier quote on our broker portal and also notify the broker via e-email.     
A carrier may quote multiple times through this endpoint, but please note that each time the broker will be notified.

If a carrier is disqualified for this broker or marked as no dispatch, the broker may not receive this notification.

params.description: Quote ID that you are retrieving

items.docs:
Cancels/expires a quote that hasn't been accepted yet. A canceled quote is still shown to the broker but cannot be automatically booked.

If the quote was already accepted, please use the Reservation `/drop` endpoint to cancel the reservation.
